title: OwnedPart
description: Ownership memory (owner: Lane A). A part the buyer already has; the buyer agent never re-buys it unless asked and cites this entry when it skips a line.

item_name.description: What the buyer called it, e.g. 'Corsair RM750e'.

acquired_on.description: ISO date, or empty if the buyer did not say.

notes.description: The buyer's own words and when they said them; quoted on the card.
